reviews.rationale: Human review decision: the current manual (30 lb, 4-30 lb range) is authoritative over the legacy gallery-image overlay. Manual is the primary safety authority for a child-restraint limit.

The 35 lb figure comes from a legacy official gallery image predating the product rename (35 Lite LX -> Lite LX, limit changed 35->30 lb). Kept as CANDIDATE record documenting live conflicting official sources; must never be served as an answer. Closes only if Graco corrects or removes the gallery image (see gap_legacy_manual_1). TRANSCRIPTION VERIFIED by human review 2026-08-24: the quoted overlay text is actually present on the image — the extraction read it correctly; the rejection is about which source wins, not about extraction accuracy.
